description: SYBO's own analytics/telemetry layer (publisher of Subway Surfers and other SYBO titles). AnalyticsBridge is the game-facing lever that schedules WorkManager jobs to flush/upload event data over HTTPS, including while the app is closed. Detected as an in-house wrapper. Does NOT touch com.sybo.consent (the age-gate/consent layer) or com.sybo.native_sharing.

methods.name: SetupWorkerForAppClosed
methods.note: Schedules a WorkManager job to flush analytics while the app is closed — stubbing prevents the background upload from ever being scheduled

methods.name: SetupWorkerForAppRunning
methods.note: Schedules the flush-while-running worker (pulls data from the game via FlushWhileRunningCallback); fire-and-forget, the game does not await it

methods.name: StopWorkerForAppRunning
methods.note: No-op once the workers are never scheduled

protected_patterns.reason: Returns a country ISO code String the game may read/parse — a null could crash the caller
FlushWhileRunningCallback: the game-supplied callback the worker uses to pull data; never stub the callback bridge
